layer: Supplemental local Linux File/guard checks and non-native PureWindowsPath lexical semantics; native Windows NOT_RUN

commands.red: HOME=${TEST_HOME} XDG_DATA_HOME=${TEST_XDG} NOVEL_DATA_PATH=${TEST_DATA} PROJECT_ROOT="$PWD" PROMPT_PATH="$PWD/prompts" STORAGE_BACKEND=file MOCK_PROVIDER=true CREDENTIAL_VAULT_BACKEND=memory ${TEST_VENV}/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_a43_drive_prefix_identity.py -q --junitxml=${PRIVATE_DRIVE_EVIDENCE}/d80-red.xml > ${PRIVATE_DRIVE_EVIDENCE}/d80-red.log 2>&1
commands.green: HOME=${TEST_HOME} XDG_DATA_HOME=${TEST_XDG} NOVEL_DATA_PATH=${TEST_DATA} PROJECT_ROOT="$PWD" PROMPT_PATH="$PWD/prompts" STORAGE_BACKEND=file MOCK_PROVIDER=true CREDENTIAL_VAULT_BACKEND=memory ${TEST_VENV}/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_a43_drive_prefix_identity.py tests/test_file_project_lifecycle.py tests/test_a43_file_identity.py tests/test_a43_identity_references.py tests/test_a43_context_identity.py -q --junitxml=${PRIVATE_DRIVE_EVIDENCE}/guard-green.xml > ${PRIVATE_DRIVE_EVIDENCE}/guard-green.log 2>&1

compatibility: Application slug-generated IDs and original ordinary/dot legacy IDs remain supported. Drive-qualified literal POSIX legacy directory IDs are now rejected. No project rename/mutation, workflow change, timeout change, PG behavior edit or running-CI intervention.
public_policy: Raw logs stay private. Public selected JUnit is encoded with explicit executor metadata-only redaction; original and public digests are separate.
